info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Weather Alerts Settings-v2-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Settings API facilitates easy access to the configuration settings for weather alerts. This endpoint enables consumers to retrieve current alert preferences, allowing for timely notifications based on user-specific criteria. Typical users include developers building applications that require real-time weather updates and organizations that need to integrate alert settings into their systems. By utilizing these settings, businesses can enhance user engagement and ensure that critical weather information is delivered efficiently.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the existing alert settings defined in the system. You can use this information to understand how alerts are configured and respond accordingly.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving alert settings. This request allows clients to specify parameters for retrieving the desired alert configurations in JSON format.

ListWeatherAlertsSettingsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on the alerts settings.
